findings.title: Brand look-alike 'paypal' appears in the subdomain of an unrelated domain
evidence: Subdomain token 'paypa1' becomes 'paypal' after homoglyph normalisation.
The registrable domain — the part that actually identifies who controls the site — is 'verify-account.xyz'.
Everything before the registrable domain is chosen freely by its owner; phishing kits exploit this to display a trusted name in the URL.

findings.title: Hostname/path contains keywords common in phishing URLs
evidence: These words are also common in legitimate URLs; on their own they are not evidence of fraud.

findings.title: Domain uses the '.xyz' TLD, which is frequently abused
evidence: Free/cheap or heavily-abused TLDs appear in a disproportionate share of phishing; many legitimate sites use them too.

findings.title: Domain does not currently resolve
